note: Proposal only. Not a batch manifest: it lives outside factory/batches/, carries no jobs, release, recipient or money, and nothing reads it at launch. Founder approval plus a separately reviewed admission change are required before any real manifest is built from it.
creation_accounting: Every VM creation counts once: initial lifecycles, checkpoint resumes, diagnosis resumes, extensions, factory-bug resumes, replacements and infrastructure retries. Reaching 48 stops new admissions; it is never raised silently.

completion_timeout_context.pilot_cutoff_source: docs/designs/pilot-run.md (diagnosis experiment that expects unfinished cases; not a completion timeout)

concurrency_rule: Stay at 1 until parallel admission, spending and cleanup are qualified (docs/cloud-handoff.md checklist).
ramp_rule: Skip milestones already satisfied; audit finished cases while independent builds continue.
replacement_policy: As ENGINEERING section 3: a case out of rounds or budget goes to diagnosis and a replacement launches at once; both count toward the 48 creations.

roles.rule: Reference to the already reviewed pins; this proposal adds and changes no model route.

historical_yield.interpretation: Descriptive counts from legacy stopped, failed and partial gate records; not a production completion-rate sample.

shortfall_estimate: No defensible completed-case yield forecast is established. The legacy 3/50 G1-G15 ratio is descriptive and mixes stopped, failed and partially qualified historical runs. Measure accepted-case yield, duration and cost through the repaired three-case completion pilot; report any actual shortfall without increasing bounds or lowering quality.
blockers: Legacy recovery: fcde6b is quarantined. 86b100 and 18681d require repaired-content full qualification, fairness/calibration, rehearsal, dedup, registry admission and reseal; historical gate passes alone do not authorize acceptance.
Reviewed admission change: pilot-bounded-roles admission is bound to b-real-pilot with exactly three templates.
Saved no-model smoke lifecycle qualification (collection, ACK/publication, same-stop usage, deletion, settlement).
Parallel admission, spending and cleanup qualification before concurrency above 1.

recovery_dispositions.fcde6b: quarantined after reproduced correctness failure; no routine recovery spend
recovery_dispositions.86b100: scoped repair/diagnostic only; full qualification and reseal pending
recovery_dispositions.18681d: scoped repair only; fresh race qualification, full pipeline and reseal pending

replacement_policy_scope: The automatic replacement rule describes the eventual factory target. The proposed initial three-case completion pilot has no replacements and a six-lifecycle/two-per-case bound; do not apply the eventual production replacement target to that pilot.
